params.text:
## Try it

- Draw a digit on the pad with the mouse.
- Flip Reset up, then down again.
- Wait for the Done lamp to light.
- The 7-segment shows the prediction.

### One pixel per clock

Two counters walk x and y from 0 to 28. Each lane adds that pixel's weight to its own total. A dark pixel reads a cell that holds zero, so nothing is added.

### The bias rides along

On the last cycle both counters read 28, the pixel is forced high, and every lane adds the word at that address: its bias, plus the offset that keeps scores positive.

### Loading your own weights

Each lane's ROM holds one row of the weight matrix at address y*32+x. Run train_mnist.py to train the same model on MNIST and write the ROM images back into this file.
